import numpy as np, json, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape
    bg=g[0,0]
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(g.flat); 
    # shape color = most common non-bg? demo2 shape 0 count 16 vs bg 3; markers count 1 or 2.
    # identify shape: largest connected component excluding bg
    lab,nl=scipy.ndimage.label(g!=bg)
    sizes=np.bincount(lab.flat)[1:]
    big=nl[np.argmax(sizes)] if len(sizes)>0 else None
    sh_cells=set(map(tuple,np.argwhere(np.array(g)!=bg)))
    # markers: colors appearing outside main shape
    sh_color=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg and np.all(g[tuple(p)]==v for p in set(sh_cells))]
    # determine shape color as the color with largest count among non-bg

i,o=G['Demo pair 3 input'],G['Demo pair 3 output']
def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rest=[c for c,_ in cnt.most_common() if c!=bg]
    # find single-cell color (seed) and multi-cell block
    colors={}
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            colors.setdefault(inp[r][c],[]).append((r,c))
    seed=[c for c,v in colors.items() if len(v)==1][0]
    block=[c for c in colors if len(colors[c])>1][0]
    s=colors[seed][0]; b=colors[block]
    mr=min(r for r,_ in b); M=max(r for r,_ in b); mc=min(c for _,c in b); Mc=max(c for _,c in b)
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    dr,dc=s[0]-M,s[1]-mc
    for (r,c) in b:
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: out[rr][cc]=seed
    return out
print(f(i)==o)
# apply to test
res=f(G['Test input'])

from collections import Counter
import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
    G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k=m[1]; h,w=int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]
        if k not in G and all(len(r.split())==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r.split()) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def obj_cells(inp,color=None):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r if x!=bg)
    if color is None: color=[c for c in cs if cs[c]>1][0]
    return [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==color]
for p in ['3','4','5']:
    i_,o_=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    oc=obj_cells(i_)
    sc=list(Counter(x for row in i_ for x in row).items())
    bgc=max(sc,key=lambda x:x[1])[0]
    colors={c:v for c,v in sc if c!=bgc}
    single=[c for c,v in colors.items() if v==1][0]
    seeds=[(r,c) for r,c in obj_cells(i_,single)]
    sr,ssc=seeds[0]
    # find all translations t such that object+t ⊆ set of seed-color cells in output, excluding original
    outc=set((r,c) for r in range(len(o_)) for c in range(len(o_[0])) if o_[r][c]==single)
    outorig=set(obj_cells(i_)) if len(obj_cells(i_,single))==0 else None
    translations=[]
    for (r0,c0) in set((r-sr,c-ssc) for r,c in obj_cells(i_)):
        t=(r0-sr,c0-ssc)
        moved={(r+t[0],c+t[1]) for r,c in obj_cells(i_)}
        if moved <= outc and not (moved & outorig)==None or True:
            translations.append(t)
    print(p,'seed',(sr,ssc),'obj cells',len(oc))
    # simpler: stamps = connected components of seed-colored cells in output minus original object cells
    comps=[]
    seen=set()
    for (r,c) in outc:
        if (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; comp=set()
        while stack:
            x,y=stack.pop()
            if (x,y) in comp or (x,y) in {(r0,c0) for r0,c0 in obj_cells(i_)}: continue
            comp.add((x,y)); seen.add((x,y))
            for dx in(-1,1):
                for dy in(-1,1):
                    nb=(x+dx,y+dy)
                    if 0<=nb[0]<len(o_) and 0<=nb[1]<len(o_[0]) and nb in outc and nb not in comp: stack.append(nb)
        comps.append(sorted(comp))
    print('  stamps:',[(min(r for r,_ in cp),min(c for _,c in cp)) for cp in comps])

import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
    G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,m2,m3=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=t[m.end():].split('\n')[:m2]
        if k not in G and all(len(r.split())==m3 and all(x.isdigit() for x in r.split()) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    shapes={}
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if inp[r][c]!=bg: shapes.setdefault(inp[r][c],[]).append((r,c))
    singlekeys={k:v[0] for k,v in shapes.items() if len(v)==1}
    multi=[v for v in shapes.values() if len(v)>1]
    if not multi: return [row[:] for row in inp]
    skeys=list(singlekeys)
    # find which color has many cells: pick the larger
    multi.sort(key=len,reverse=True); objcells=multi[0]
    # seed color: any color appearing once besides those already excluded? assume remaining
    seedcolor=None
    for k in singlekeys:
        if any(k!=inp[r][c] for r,c in objcells):
            seedcolor=k
    sr,ssc=singlekeys[seedcolor]
    mr=min(r for r,_ in objcells); rmax=max(r for r,_ in objcells)
    mc=min(c for _,c in objcells); Mc2=max(c for _,c in objcells)
    bh=rmax-mr+1; bw=Mc2-mc+1
    dr=-1 if sr<mr else (1 if sr>rmax else 0)
    dc=-1 if ssc<mc else (1 if ssc>Mc2 else 0)
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    k=1
    while True:
        tl=(mr+k*dr*bh, mc+k*dc*bw)
        placed=False
        for (r,c) in objcells:
            rr,cc=r+tl[0],c+tl[1]
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: out[rr][cc]=inp[sr][ssc]; placed=True
        if not placed: break
        k+=1
    return out
for p in ['3','4','5','6']:
    i_,o_=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    e=f(i_)
    miss=sum(1 for r in range(min(len(o_),len(e))) for c in range(min(len(o_[0]),len(e[0]))) if o_[r][c]!=e[r][c])
    print(p, e==o_)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])) if False else '')

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    coms=[]
    for R in range(H):
        for C in range(W):
            if inp[R][C]!=0 and not seen[R][C]:
                col=inp[R][C]; q=[(R,C)]; seen[R][C]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    rr,cc=q.pop()
                    cells.append((rr,cc))
                    for dr2 in(-1,0,1):
                        for dc2 in(-1,0,1):
                            nr,nc=rr+dr2,cc+dc2
                            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and not seen[nr][nc] and inp[nr][nc]==col:
                                seen[nr][nc]=True; q.append((nr,nc))
                coms.append((col,cells))
    objcells=max(coms,key=lambda t:len(t[1]))[1]
    sing=[(col,cells[0]) for col,cells in coms if len(cells)==1]
    sr,ssc=sing[0]
    mr=min(R for R,_ in objcells); rmax=max(R for R,_ in objcells)
    mc=min(C for _,C in objcells); Mc2=max(C for _,C in objcells)
    bh=rmax-mr+1; bw=Mc2-mc+1
    dr=-1 if sr<mr else (1 if sr>rmax else 0)
    dc=-1 if ssc<mc else (1 if ssc>Mc2 else 0)
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    k=1
    while True:
        tl=(mr+k*dr*bh, mc+k*dc*bw)
        placed=False
        for (r2,c2) in objcells:
            rr,cc=r2+tl[0],c2+tl[1]
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: out[rr][cc]=inp[sr][ssc]; placed=True
        if not placed: break
        k+=1
    return out

import json
def solve(inp):
    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    # find the 6 marker
    six=None
    for r,row in enumerate(inp):
        for c,x in enumerate(row):
            if x==6: six=(r,c)
    # find zero shape bbox
    zs=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(inp) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==0]
    rs=[p[0] for p in zs]; cs=[p[1] for p in zs]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    # assume hollow 3x3; marker says next copy placement: copies step by (3,-3)
    # determine direction from marker relative to shape
    if six is not None:
        # step = marker - closest shape cornerish? use: copies continue staircase
        pass
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    dr,dc=3,-3
    # place copies at offsets k*(dr,dc) for k>=1, anchored so they tile below-left of shape
    # anchor: first copy top-left = shape_tl + (dr,dc)
    base=(r0+dr,c0+dc)
    for k in range(1,100):
        br,bc=base+(k*dr,k*dc)
        br1,bc1=br+2,bc+2
        if br1>=H or bc1>=W or br<0 or bc<0: break
        for rr in range(br,br1+1):
            for cc in range(bc,bc1+1):
                if inp[rr][cc]==0 or inp[rr][cc]==6: continue
                out[rr][cc]=6
    return out

import json
def solve(inp):
    H=len(inp); W=len(inp[0])
    # background = most common color; shape = all others (non-bg) cells
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in inp for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    s=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(inp) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x!=bg]
    rs=[p[0] for p in s]; cs=[p[1] for p in s]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    m=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in s]
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    k=1
    while True:
        br=r0+k*(r1-r0+1); bc=c0-k*(c1-c0+1)
        # step size = shape height/width; direction down-left
        ph,rh=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        br+=ph*k; bc-=rh*k
        placed=False
        for rr,cc in m:
            nr,nc=br+rr,bc+cc
            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W:
                if inp[nr][nc]==bg:
                    out[nr][nc]=6; placed=True
                else:
                    out[nr][nc]=bg  # don't overwrite original shape
        k+=1
        if not placed or br>=H: break
    return out
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Demo pair 6 input']))==json.dumps(G['Demo pair 6 output']))

def solve(inp):
    c=collections.Counter(x for row in inp for x in row)

    ph=r1-r0+1; pw=c1-c0+1
    offs=[(i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in pats]
    y,x=mks[0][0],mks[0][1]-pw
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    while True:
        ok=any(0<=y+a<len(inp) and 0<=x+b<len(inp[0]) for a,b in offs)

def solve_greedy(inp):
    cc=collections.Counter(v for row in inp for v in row); bg=max(cc,key=lambda v:cc[v])
    others=[v for v in cc if v!=bg]; pat=max(others,key=lambda v:cc[v]); mk=min(others,key=lambda v:cc[v])
    pps=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(inp) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==pat]
    r0=min(i for i,j in pps); c0=min(j for i,j in pps)
    h_=max(i for i,j in pps)-r0+1; w_=max(j for i,j in pps)-c0+1
    offs=[(i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in pps]
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    mks=set((i,j) for i,row in enumerate(inp) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==mk)
    # candidate placements (any within bounds, cells all bg or marker)
    cands=[(ai,aj) for ai in range(H-h_+1) for aj in range(W-w_+1)
           if all(0<=ai+a<H and 0<=aj+b<W and (inp[ai+a][aj+b]==bg or (ai+a,aj+b) in mks) for a,b in offs)]
    seed=set(pps)  # original pattern cells
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    cur=set(seed)
    # grow: repeatedly add a candidate placement that touches current union (chebyshev adj of some cell) & is valid under current out (cells either bg or already stamped/mk)
    for _ in range(100):
        added=False
        for (ai,aj) in cands:
            s=set((ai+a,aj+b) for a,b in offs)
            if not (s & cur) or len(s-cur)>0: continue
            if s & cur: 
                # check remaining free cells are bg
                free={p for p in s if inp[p]!=bg}
                if all(p in mks for p in free):
                    pass
            # validity under current painting: stamped cells must stay, bg cells become mk
            for a,b in offs:
                ii,jj=ai+a,aj+b
                if inp[ii][jj]==bg and out[ii][jj]!=bg: return None
            if s & cur:
